SC-32

USER GUIDE
1. WHAT IS THIS MANIPULATIVE?
4-REGISTER RPN AUTOMATIC STACK ENGINE
The SC-32 uses Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) with a 4-register stack.Numbers are pushed onto the stack; operations consume them immediately: Stack Architecture: Registers T, Z, Y, X (Display)Zero parentheses, zero operator precedence confusion, and zero syntax errors.Intermediate calculations wait safely on the stack until an operator needs them!
CALIBRATED 32-KEYCAP TACTILE HARDWARE {xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n
TRAVEL CADDY DESK STAND LID
The modular travel caddy features an angled desk operating standand TPU protective membrane cushion. Keep your calculator proppedat the optimal viewing angle beside your blocks while calculating!
4-REGISTER RPN STACK: √(3² + 4²) = 5.0000
T: 0.0000
Z: 0.0000
Y: 16.0000
X: 9.0000
STACK DYNAMICS Press [+]: Drops Y into X → X = 25.0000 Press [√x]: → X = 5.0000 (Hypotenuse) Zero parentheses needed!

3. WHY KEEP THIS REFERENCE CARD?
✓ NO LOST PIECE LEFT BEHIND
Classroom manipulatives get lost. Never abandon an incomplete set! Every individual math component is permanently stocked for single replacements.
Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts Order individual replacement pieces anytime
✓ 10-SECOND SELF-CHECKING PACK-UP
Pack-up is a built-in math game! Slip the calculator into its TPUmembrane cushion, seat into the travel caddy recess, and coil thebraided USB-C cable in the rear storage trough. Stand lid snaps shut.Magnetic latches hold firmly for silent, crush-proof protection.
✓ HANDS-ON TUTORIAL ON REVERSE
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage arrangements, calculator cross-references, and core mathematical principle breakthrough! Keep this card stored inside the box lid!
